"""Add a cover page with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date to report.pdf."""
import os
import tempfile
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

REPORT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "_cover_tmp.pdf"
OUTPUT_TMP = "_report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        raise SystemExit(f"Error: {REPORT} not found in {os.getcwd()}")

    original_count = len(PdfReader(REPORT).pages)

    # 1. Create the cover page (US Letter) with title and current date.
    width, height = letter
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    c.setFont("Times-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 30, "Annual Financial Report")
    c.setFont("Times-Roman", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_str)
    c.save()

    # 2. Merge the cover page in front of report.pdf.
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
    report_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_TMP, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # 3. Atomically replace report.pdf with the merged document.
    os.replace(OUTPUT_TMP, REPORT)

    # 4. Verify.
    final_count = len(PdfReader(REPORT).pages)
    assert final_count == original_count + 1, "Page count mismatch after merge"
    os.remove(COVER)

    print(f"Updated {REPORT}")
    print(f"  Cover page title: 'Annual Financial Report'")
    print(f"  Cover page date:  {date_str}")
    print(f"  Pages: {original_count} -> {final_count}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The cover page contains the exact title 'Annual Financial Report' and the
operator runtime's current date. Implemented with only the Python standard
library (zlib, re, datetime, os): it parses report.pdf's simple classic-xref
structure, renumbers its objects, prepends hand-built cover-page objects, and
rewrites the PDF. Only report.pdf is transformed; the only other artifacts are
task-scoped temporaries and a validation-image directory.

import datetime
import os
import re
import zlib

REPORT = "report.pdf"
MERGED_TMP = ".report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
VALIDATION_DIR = "cover_validation_pages"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# Standard Helvetica widths (1/1000 em) for ASCII 32..126.
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = [
    278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278,
    556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556,
    1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833, 722, 778,
    667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278, 278, 278, 469, 556,
    333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833, 556, 556,
    556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500, 334, 260, 334, 584,
]


def text_width(text, size):
    total = 0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        total += HELVETICA_WIDTHS[code - 32] if 32 <= code <= 126 else 500
    return total * size / 1000.0


def escape_pdf_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def parse_objects(pdf_bytes):
    """Return {obj_num: body_bytes} for every 'N 0 obj ... endobj' object."""
    objects = {}
    pattern = re.compile(rb"(\d+) 0 obj\n(.*?)endobj", re.DOTALL)
    for match in pattern.finditer(pdf_bytes):
        objects[int(match.group(1))] = match.group(2)
    return objects


def renumber_body(body, mapping):
    """Renumber 'N 0 obj' and 'N 0 R' references in the header (pre-stream)
    portion of an object body, leaving stream data untouched."""
    if b"\nstream\n" in body:
        header, sep, stream = body.partition(b"\nstream\n")
        stream = stream[: stream.rfind(b"endstream")] + b"endstream"
    else:
        header, sep, stream = body, b"", b""

    def repl(match):
        num = int(match.group(1))
        return str(mapping.get(num, num)).encode() + match.group(2)

    new_header = re.sub(rb"(\d+) 0 obj", repl, header)
    new_header = re.sub(rb"(\d+) 0 R", repl, new_header)
    return new_header + sep + stream


def main():
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_text = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        raise SystemExit(f"FAILURE: {REPORT} not found")

    with open(REPORT, "rb") as f:
        original_bytes = f.read()
    if not original_bytes.startswith(b"%PDF-"):
        raise SystemExit("FAILURE: report.pdf is not a PDF file")

    original_objects = parse_objects(original_bytes)
    if set(original_objects) != set(range(1, 9)):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"FAILURE: unexpected object layout in report.pdf: {sorted(original_objects)}"
        )

    # New numbering: cover objects 1-6, original objects 1..8 -> 7..14.
    mapping = {1: 7, 2: 8, 3: 9, 4: 10, 5: 11, 6: 12, 7: 13, 8: 14}

    # ---- Build the cover page content stream (Flate-compressed) ----
    title_x = (612 - text_width(TITLE, 28)) / 2.0
    date_x = (612 - text_width(date_text, 16)) / 2.0
    content = (
        f"BT /F2 28 Tf {title_x:.2f} 492 Td ({escape_pdf_text(TITLE)}) Tj ET\n"
        "0.75 w 100 470 m 512 470 l S\n"
        f"BT /F1 16 Tf {date_x:.2f} 430 Td ({escape_pdf_text(date_text)}) Tj ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    cover_stream = zlib.compress(content)

    # ---- Assemble the new PDF objects ----
    new_objects = [
        (1, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /PageMode /UseNone >>"),
        (2, b"<< /Type /Pages /Count 2 /Kids [3 0 R 13 0 R] >>"),
        (3, b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> /ProcSet [/PDF /Text] >> "
            b"/Contents 4 0 R >>"),
        (4, b"<< /Filter /FlateDecode /Length " + str(len(cover_stream)).encode() +
            b" >>\nstream\n" + cover_stream + b"\nendstream"),
        (5, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica "
            b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"),
        (6, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
            b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"),
    ]
    for orig_num in range(1, 9):
        new_objects.append((mapping[orig_num], renumber_body(original_objects[orig_num], mapping)))
    new_objects.sort()

    # ---- Write the rebuilt PDF with a fresh classic xref table ----
    lines = [b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"]
    offsets = {}
    for num, body in new_objects:
        offsets[num] = sum(len(line) for line in lines)
        lines.append(f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\nendobj\n")

    xref_offset = sum(len(line) for line in lines)
    count = len(new_objects) + 1  # object 0 entry
    xref = [f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode(), b"0000000000 65535 f \n"]
    for num, _ in new_objects:
        xref.append(f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    lines.append(b"".join(xref))
    lines.append(
        b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(count).encode() + b" /Root 1 0 R /Info 12 0 R >>\n"
    )
    lines.append(f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n".encode())

    with open(MERGED_TMP, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"".join(lines))

    # ---- Validate the rebuilt document before replacing report.pdf ----
    with open(MERGED_TMP, "rb") as f:
        rebuilt = f.read()
    assert rebuilt.startswith(b"%PDF-1.4"), "bad header"
    rebuilt_objects = parse_objects(rebuilt)
    assert len(rebuilt_objects) == 14, "object count mismatch"
    assert b"/Count 2 /Kids [3 0 R 13 0 R]" in rebuilt_objects[2], "pages tree mismatch"
    # Decompress the cover content stream and check for title + date.
    cover_obj = rebuilt_objects[4]
    stream_start = cover_obj.index(b"stream\n") + len(b"stream\n")
    stream_end = cover_obj.index(b"endstream")
    cover_data = zlib.decompress(cover_obj[stream_start:stream_end])
    assert TITLE.encode("latin-1") in cover_data, "title missing from cover"
    assert date_text.encode("latin-1") in cover_data, "date missing from cover"
    # Original page content stream must still be present (object 14).
    assert b"endstream" in rebuilt_objects[14], "original content stream missing"

    os.replace(MERGED_TMP, REPORT)

    # ---- Validate the final report.pdf on disk ----
    with open(REPORT, "rb") as f:
        final_bytes = f.read()
    final_objects = parse_objects(final_bytes)
    assert len(final_objects) == 14, "final object count mismatch"
    final_cover = final_objects[4]
    s0 = final_cover.index(b"stream\n") + len(b"stream\n")
    s1 = final_cover.index(b"endstream")
    final_data = zlib.decompress(final_cover[s0:s1])
    assert TITLE.encode("latin-1") in final_data, "final cover title missing"
    assert date_text.encode("latin-1") in final_data, "final cover date missing"
    assert b"startxref" in final_bytes and b"%%EOF" in final_bytes

    os.makedirs(VALIDATION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"SUCCESS: report.pdf now has a cover page prepended with title "
          f"'{TITLE}' and date '{date_text}' (14 objects, 2 pages in the tree)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The cover page contains the exact title 'Annual Financial Report' and the
operator runtime's current date. Implemented with only the Python standard
library (zlib, re, datetime, os): it parses report.pdf's simple classic-xref
structure, renumbers its objects, prepends hand-built cover-page objects, and
rewrites the PDF. Only report.pdf is transformed; the only other artifacts are
task-scoped temporaries and a validation-image directory.
"""

import os
import re
import zlib

REPORT = "report.pdf"
MERGED_TMP = ".report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
VALIDATION_DIR = "cover_validation_pages"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# Standard Helvetica widths (1/1000 em) for ASCII 32..126.
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = [
    278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278,
    556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 556, 278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556,
    1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833, 722, 778,
    667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278, 278, 278, 469, 556,
    333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556, 278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833, 556, 556,
    556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500, 334, 260, 334, 584,
]


def text_width(text, size):
    total = 0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        total += HELVETICA_WIDTHS[code - 32] if 32 <= code <= 126 else 500
    return total * size / 1000.0


def escape_pdf_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def parse_objects(pdf_bytes):
    """Return {obj_num: body_bytes} for every 'N 0 obj ... endobj' object."""
    objects = {}
    pattern = re.compile(rb"(\d+) 0 obj\n(.*?)endobj", re.DOTALL)
    for match in pattern.finditer(pdf_bytes):
        objects[int(match.group(1))] = match.group(2)
    return objects


def renumber_body(body, mapping):
    """Renumber 'N 0 obj' and 'N 0 R' references in the header (pre-stream)
    portion of an object body, leaving stream data untouched."""
    if b"\nstream\n" in body:
        header, sep, stream = body.partition(b"\nstream\n")
        stream = stream[: stream.rfind(b"endstream")] + b"endstream"
    else:
        header, sep, stream = body, b"", b""

    def repl(match):
        num = int(match.group(1))
        return str(mapping.get(num, num)).encode() + match.group(2)

    new_header = re.sub(rb"(\d+) 0 obj", repl, header)
    new_header = re.sub(rb"(\d+) 0 R", repl, new_header)
    return new_header + sep + stream


def main():
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_text = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        raise SystemExit(f"FAILURE: {REPORT} not found")

    with open(REPORT, "rb") as f:
        original_bytes = f.read()
    if not original_bytes.startswith(b"%PDF-"):
        raise SystemExit("FAILURE: report.pdf is not a PDF file")

    original_objects = parse_objects(original_bytes)
    if set(original_objects) != set(range(1, 9)):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"FAILURE: unexpected object layout in report.pdf: {sorted(original_objects)}"
        )

    # New numbering: cover objects 1-6, original objects 1..8 -> 7..14.
    mapping = {1: 7, 2: 8, 3: 9, 4: 10, 5: 11, 6: 12, 7: 13, 8: 14}

    # ---- Build the cover page content stream (Flate-compressed) ----
    title_x = (612 - text_width(TITLE, 28)) / 2.0
    date_x = (612 - text_width(date_text, 16)) / 2.0
    content = (
        f"BT /F2 28 Tf {title_x:.2f} 492 Td ({escape_pdf_text(TITLE)}) Tj ET\n"
        "0.75 w 100 470 m 512 470 l S\n"
        f"BT /F1 16 Tf {date_x:.2f} 430 Td ({escape_pdf_text(date_text)}) Tj ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    cover_stream = zlib.compress(content)

    # ---- Assemble the new PDF objects ----
    new_objects = [
        (1, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /PageMode /UseNone >>"),
        (2, b"<< /Type /Pages /Count 2 /Kids [3 0 R 13 0 R] >>"),
        (3, b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> /ProcSet [/PDF /Text] >> "
            b"/Contents 4 0 R >>"),
        (4, b"<< /Filter /FlateDecode /Length " + str(len(cover_stream)).encode() +
            b" >>\nstream\n" + cover_stream + b"\nendstream"),
        (5, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica "
            b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"),
        (6, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
            b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"),
    ]
    for orig_num in range(1, 9):
        new_objects.append((mapping[orig_num], renumber_body(original_objects[orig_num], mapping)))
    new_objects.sort()

    # ---- Write the rebuilt PDF with a fresh classic xref table ----
    lines = [b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"]
    offsets = {}
    for num, body in new_objects:
        offsets[num] = sum(len(line) for line in lines)
        lines.append(f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\nendobj\n")

    xref_offset = sum(len(line) for line in lines)
    count = len(new_objects) + 1  # object 0 entry
    xref = [f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode(), b"0000000000 65535 f \n"]
    for num, _ in new_objects:
        xref.append(f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    lines.append(b"".join(xref))
    lines.append(
        b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(count).encode() + b" /Root 1 0 R /Info 12 0 R >>\n"
    )
    lines.append(f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n".encode())

    with open(MERGED_TMP, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"".join(lines))

    # ---- Validate the rebuilt document before replacing report.pdf ----
    with open(MERGED_TMP, "rb") as f:
        rebuilt = f.read()
    assert rebuilt.startswith(b"%PDF-1.4"), "bad header"
    rebuilt_objects = parse_objects(rebuilt)
    assert len(rebuilt_objects) == 14, "object count mismatch"
    assert b"/Count 2 /Kids [3 0 R 13 0 R]" in rebuilt_objects[2], "pages tree mismatch"
    # Decompress the cover content stream and check for title + date.
    cover_obj = rebuilt_objects[4]
    stream_start = cover_obj.index(b"stream\n") + len(b"stream\n")
    stream_end = cover_obj.index(b"endstream")
    cover_data = zlib.decompress(cover_obj[stream_start:stream_end])
    assert TITLE.encode("latin-1") in cover_data, "title missing from cover"
    assert date_text.encode("latin-1") in cover_data, "date missing from cover"
    # Original page content stream must still be present (object 14).
    assert b"endstream" in rebuilt_objects[14], "original content stream missing"

    os.replace(MERGED_TMP, REPORT)

    # ---- Validate the final report.pdf on disk ----
    with open(REPORT, "rb") as f:
        final_bytes = f.read()
    final_objects = parse_objects(final_bytes)
    assert len(final_objects) == 14, "final object count mismatch"
    final_cover = final_objects[4]
    s0 = final_cover.index(b"stream\n") + len(b"stream\n")
    s1 = final_cover.index(b"endstream")
    final_data = zlib.decompress(final_cover[s0:s1])
    assert TITLE.encode("latin-1") in final_data, "final cover title missing"
    assert date_text.encode("latin-1") in final_data, "final cover date missing"
    assert b"startxref" in final_bytes and b"%%EOF" in final_bytes

    os.makedirs(VALIDATION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"SUCCESS: report.pdf now has a cover page prepended with title "
          f"'{TITLE}' and date '{date_text}' (14 objects, 2 pages in the tree)")
